strategy_roster.name: NDay Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Donchian 20-bar breakout with 20-bar MA trend filter (LookbackPeriod=20, MaPeriod=20). StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Hull MA Trend
strategy_roster.notes: Hull MA(9) trend: fast EMA(9) above slow EMA(18) approximates rising Hull slope (HmaPeriod=9). ATR trailing stop not representable as fixed pct; left null.

strategy_roster.name: Super Trend
strategy_roster.notes: Super Trend (Period=10, Multiplier=3.0): long above upper band, exit below lower band. Corpus has no fixed stop; uses ATR-based dynamic stop.

strategy_roster.name: Double Bottom Pattern
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= donchian_low_prev(low,5) and close > open and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Double bottom: price makes a low within prior 5 bars then closes bullish above MA(20). Distance=5, SimilarityPercent=2.0. StopLoss=1% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Shooting Star Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and (high - close) >= 2 * (close - open) and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: After shooting star (upper shadow >= 2x body), wait for bullish confirmation close above MA(20). ShadowToBodyRatio=2.0. StopLoss=1%.

strategy_roster.name: Heikin-Ashi Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: Heikin-Ashi color change: bullish HA candle (close>open) breaking prior high. HA values approximated from raw candles. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Tweezer Bottom
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= donchian_low_prev(low,2) and close > open and close > donchian_high_prev(high,1)
strategy_roster.notes: Tweezer bottom: two candles share a low within 2 bars, then close bullish above prior high. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Engulfing Candlestick
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close >= donchian_high_prev(high,1) and open <= donchian_low_prev(low,1)
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish engulfing: current candle fully engulfs prior candle range. HoldPeriods=17 bars exit approximated by channel break. No fixed stop documented.

strategy_roster.name: Hammer & Shooting Star
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and (open - low) >= 2 * (close - open) and (high - close) <= (close - open)
strategy_roster.notes: Hammer candle: lower shadow >= 2x body, upper shadow <= body. Long WickFactor=0.9, MaxOppositeWickFactor=0.45, MinBodyRangePct=0.2. No fixed stop; exit on prior low break.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Trend
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9) above signal and zero line. StopLoss=2% documented. Note: similar to batch_002 ID=91 but uses state-based entry vs cross.
